_comment: Curated bout index for the Bruno Fernandes Rocha frame batch (4 bouts, manifest data/frame_pdf/bruno_rocha.json).
Procedure: docs/gemini_concordance_audit.md. Unlike data/frame_pdf/trials_2023_24_bouts.json (one shared event
recording), every entry here is its OWN single-bout FloGrappling video, so `start`/`end` are that video's own
frame span and `video_id` (the number after /video/ in the Flo URL, also the tail of the sheet slug) is what
matches a reading to its bout -- the timestamp scan cannot, because all four videos start at ts 0.
`label` is 'Winner vs. Loser': the winner is FORCED from it, so each one is recorded below with how it was
verified independently of any model reading.
16132708 Rafael Silverio da Fonseca -- broadcast 'VENCEDOR RAFAEL SILVERIO DA FONSECA' card at t=382, plus
the scoreboard reading 0 x 9 (+1 vantagem) and the referee raising the black-gi athlete's arm at t=379.
15547218 Keven Julio -- referee raises the light-blue-rashguard athlete's arm at t=183-186; the OTHER body
(royal-blue rashguard, cyan tape on the left ankle, right-shin tattoo) is the one whose arm is raised
as the winner of video 15546999, and Bruno is the only athlete in both videos, so that body is Bruno.
15546999 Bruno Fernandes Rocha -- referee raises his arm at t=123; same body/kit as in 15547218 (same event day).
16045240 Joao Cleber Araujo Borges -- final scoreboard at t=520 reads JOAO CLEBER 12 (4 adv, 1 pen) x 0 BRUNO
FERNANDES ROCHA (1 adv), and the referee raises the purple-rashguard athlete's arm at t=528.
`bout_start` is clock-derived by the curator (countdown clock read at 720p) and overrides whatever a reading
claimed. 16045240 has none: at the first sampled frame the bout is already running (clock 6:40, score 0x0 at
t=15), so the bout starts BEFORE this video does and no non-negative value is true.
